name: Environmental Committee Regular Meeting Agenda (PDF)
agenda_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  ENVIRONMENTAL COMMITTEE
  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting

  Thursday, September 12, 2019 - 7:00 pm
  Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First St.
  Conference Room A, Second Floor

I.  Roll Call
  John Vuong
  Kim Luu
  Michael Daninger

II.  Flag Salute.

III.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS
  Each year the committee is appointed by the City Council. At that time it is
  appropriate to conduct an election to determine which members will chair the
  meeting as president and in the event the chair cannot attend the meeting,
  determine which member will step in as Vice President to conduct the meeting.
  Recommended Action: That the Committee elect a new president and vice
  president to chair the meeting.

IV.  MEASURE W OVERVIEW
  Deputy Director David Dolphin will present an overview of Measure W, the Safe
  Clean Water Act and what this means for stormwater.
  Recommended Action: Information only. No action required

V.  PUBLIC COMMENTS
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments are
  welcome, but must pertain to the business of the Alhambra Environmental
  Committee. Please limit all oral communication to five (5) minutes. Speakers
  must fill out a blue speaker’s card, prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary. Comments must pertain to the business of the
  Environmental Committee. Please limit all oral communications to five (5)
  minutes.

VI.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee members of any item not specified on the agenda.
  Items must pertain to the business of the Alhambra Environmental Committee.

VII. Adjournment

If you wish to address the Committee during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s
card and give it to the secretary. When making your presentation, please give your name
 and address for the record. Please make your statement as brief as possible. The
maximum time for addressing the Committee is five minutes.

If you wish to address the Committee on an item which appears on the agenda, your
comments will be heard during the Committee’s discussion of that item. If you wish to
address the Committee on a subject which does not appear on the agenda, but is of an
environmental concern, your comments will be heard under Public Comments. Please be
advised that under the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, the committee cannot
take action on any item which does not appear on the agenda.

Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business
described above are on file in the Utilities Department office and are available for public
inspection upon request during regular office hours, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.
to 5:00 p.m. Any question concerning agenda items should be directed to Martin Ray,
Director of Public Works & Utilities at (626) 570-3278.
